content:
jordan: Quick heads-up: our CI went red after switching the sample pipeline to the quickstart service-account flow. Local tests with personal keys pass but CI gets 403 payment_required.
nina_support: That 403 is the paygate. We tightened rules: non-interactive/service tokens now require workspace billing consent/contact. Interactive user keys still work if user billing is configured.
jordan: This surprised us because the quickstart README shows the service-account example with no mention of billing. We'll be blocked for our staging build.
paul_sdk: Also the Go SDK in the sample retried the 403 three times which filled the logs and masked the root cause. Default retry policy treated some 4xx as transient.
aya: Minimal repro from CI logs:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
# HTTP/1.1 403
# {"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing consent required for service tokens"}
```
jordan: Need a quick workaround for tomorrow's demo.
nina_support: Short-term options: 1) use a personal key as CI secret, 2) add a billing contact/card to the workspace, or 3) send tenant id and we can whitelist for a short window. I can open a ticket.
paul_sdk: We're cutting an SDK patch to stop retrying on 4xx except 429/408. Patch will hit canary today; will add a README note in the sample repo.
jordan: We'll swap to a personal key for now and update README to call out billing consent for service tokens. Please ping when the SDK fix deploys.
devex-bot: deploy queued: sdk/no-retry-on-4xx -> canary (sha: b7c4f1).
nina_support: Ticket created (#SUP-912). DM me tenant id if you want the temporary whitelist.
jordan: Thanks all — filing a tiny docs PR now to avoid trapping other teams.
